name: From Seed to Sprout
summary: Halligan Turner has made a planting kit from the fertilizer you supplied. He asks you to plant saplings around the lumber camp’s work sites.

sections.title: A New Planting
sections.body: Halligan Turner has gathered seeds while the lumber crew works among the trees. With the fertilizer you brought, he has prepared a kit for planting them as saplings. You are asked to find places around the work sites to put them in the ground.

faq.answer: Halligan Turner made the planting kit using the fertilizer you supplied.
The kit is for planting seeds gathered from the trees and growing them into saplings.

faq.q: Where should I plant the saplings?
faq.answer: Halligan asks you to plant them around the lumber camp’s work sites.
The lumber crew cuts trees and grows new ones in their place.
